The '''Council of Three''' was the leadership of [[Mandroxan]] in the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]]. The triumvirate of crime bosses during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was [[Artur Manliss]], [[Sehvorah]] and [[Parmella Trillidor]].
